versions.changelog:
Initial beta release of alibabacloud-network-mtr-diagnosis.

- Provides a public network MTR diagnosis tool with both manual guidance and Cloud Assistant automated modes.
- Supports troubleshooting for connectivity failures, high latency, packet loss, SLB health check failures, and NAT/EIP issues.
- Manual mode instructs users to run MTR on their local machine and upload screenshots for analysis.
- Automated mode uses Alibaba Cloud Cloud Assistant to run diagnostics (mtr/ping/curl) directly on ECS instances.
- Enforces strict mode selection: no local or agent-side command execution unless running on the target ECS via Cloud Assistant.
- Requires explicit user confirmation before installing diagnostic software on ECS instances.
- Includes clear practices for bidirectional MTR, user agent tagging for all aliyun cloud calls, and strong security/observability principles.
